
# Project rules
- This is a personal portfolio website for a freelance developer and designer.
- Use only plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No Node.js, no npm, no build tools, no frameworks.
- Load GSAP and ScrollTrigger from a CDN script tag (cdnjs.cloudflare.com), pinned to a specific version.
- Dark theme, background color #1A1818. Put colors and fonts in CSS variables at the top of style.css.
- Mobile-first and accessible: semantic HTML, alt text on images, visible focus styles.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all animations.
- Explain changes in simple language because the owner is a beginner.
